notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the consumer growth product manager archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet in the EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Redesigned subscription paywall from single-screen to three-step value-then-price flow — lifted paid-conversion from 2.8% to 4.6% on ~3.1M monthly impressions; +$11.4M annualized net-new subscription revenue
Designed first-month onboarding flow driving new subscribers to use first three benefits within seven days — +21% activation lift at the seven-day mark and +9% improvement in 90-day retention
Owned price-experimentation roadmap — ran nine pricing tests across plan duration, intro-offer depth, and currency framing; reduced first-year churn from 38% to 27% on the annual plan
Led winback program redesign — replaced single batch email with behavioral-trigger system across email, push, and in-app segmented by reason-for-cancel; reactivation rate from 4.2% to 9.8%
Shepherded subscription brand refresh from Loom Goods Plus to a named program with member-only product drops and a referral program now driving 14% of new signups
Owned new-user activation funnel from app-open through first content posted — through 27 launched experiments lifted day-1 activation from 19% to 41% and day-7 retained-poster rate from 6% to 17%
Designed contact-import-driven friend graph as the cold-start mechanic giving new users an instantly populated feed — +12 percentage points to day-1 retention with policy-team-approved consent design

Built referral system from scratch with link-based invites, attribution back to the inviting user, and tiered cosmetic rewards — drove 22% of weekly new installs at $0.41 CAC versus $4.30 on paid social
Led cross-functional team that shipped iOS App Clip enabling tap-to-preview before install — +6.8% lift in install-conversion from shared-link traffic during launch quarter
Replaced 14 hand-tuned batch push notifications with model-scored personalized notification system — cut notification volume per user by 38% while lifting notification-driven sessions by 12%
Ran A/B testing infrastructure migration from homegrown allocator to Statsig — wrote experimentation playbook including pre-registration template, MDE calculator, and power-analysis review rule
Shipped Spool's first creator landing-page experience as a personalized shareable page — became single largest source of supporter signups at 47% of new accounts
Owned supporter onboarding funnel — lifted email-capture-to-paying-supporter conversion from 3.1% to 7.4% across a sequence of mostly-copy-driven experiments
Built creator analytics dashboard from scratch — designed metric set, ran user research, drove engineering scope from 14 weeks to 6 by removing what creators didn't open
Owned iOS reservation-confirmation funnel between tap and confirmed booking — shipped six experiments in twelve months for cumulative +18% in completed reservations per active user
Built and released Funnelpack — a free Jupyter notebook taking session-event CSV exports and producing activation-funnel charts with confidence-band overlays for early-stage PMs
Writes a weekly newsletter on consumer growth with funnel teardowns, paywall reviews, and growth-experiment post-mortems — ~9,800 subscribers
